name: Blistering Feint
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Blistering Feint (Combat)
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 130
Your foes flinch from the heat of your weapon, giving you an opportunity to slip past their defenses.

Prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Improved Feint, ifrit.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on feint checks made while wielding a weapon that deals fire damage. Anytime you successfully feint a creature while using such a weapon, you may deal its fire damage to the enemy.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 114
When you attempt a feint while you’re wielding a weapon that deals fire damage, you can spend up to 5 stamina points to gain a bonus on the Bluff check equal to the number of stamina points you spent.
